_comment: Delivery coverage per chain and city. None of the chains publishes a static delivery-area list (checked 2026-11-18: Shufersal, Rami Levy and Carrefour all decide coverage per street address on their own websites). Only add a city here after a person verified it on the chain's site; record the date in lastChecked. Cities not listed = unknown (the UI says 'בדוק כיסוי באתר הרשת' and keeps the chain in the comparison).
